# AddmeTour — Comprehensive Documentation for AI Agents

> AddmeTour is a premier inbound travel agency based in Baku, Azerbaijan, providing guided tours, excursion packages, private custom itineraries, and online electronic visa (ASAN Visa) processing.

## Contact Information
- Website: https://addmetour.com
- Location: Baku, Azerbaijan
- Languages Supported: English, Azerbaijani, Russian, Arabic
- WhatsApp Support: +994000000000 (Available 24/7)

## Electronic Visa (e-Visa) Service
AddmeTour assists international travelers in obtaining official electronic visas to Azerbaijan:
- Processing Options:
  - Standard Processing: 3 business days, $45 USD
  - Urgent Fast-Track: 3 hours, $85 USD
- Eligibility: Passports of over 95 countries (EU, USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, India, and more)
- Validity: 90 days validity, allowing a single entry stay of up to 30 days.
- Requirements: Valid passport copy (minimum 6 months validity remaining), entry date, accommodation details.

## Popular Tour Itineraries

### 1. Baku Old City Walking Tour
- Duration: 3 hours
- Max Group Size: 10 travelers
- Price: From $25 / person
- Highlights: UNESCO-listed Icherisheher, Maiden Tower (Qız Qalası), Palace of the Shirvanshahs, medieval caravanserais, ancient bathhouses, local tea house experience.

### 2. Gobustan & Mud Volcanoes Day Trip
- Duration: 6 hours
- Max Group Size: 8 travelers
- Price: From $55 / person
- Highlights: Gobustan National Historical-Artistic Preserve with 40,000-year-old petroglyphs, interactive museum, active cold mud volcanoes (Azerbaijan holds nearly half of the world's mud volcanoes), Bibi-Heybat Mosque.

### 3. Absheron Peninsula & Land of Fire
- Duration: 8 hours
- Max Group Size: 8 travelers
- Price: From $65 / person
- Highlights: Ateshgah Fire Temple (Zoroastrian pilgrimage sanctuary), Yanar Dag (naturally burning hillside flames), Mardakan fortress, Caspian coast.

### 4. Sheki Cultural & Mountain Foothills Excursion
- Duration: 2 days (Overnight)
- Max Group Size: 6 travelers
- Price: From $149 / person
- Highlights: Scenic drive along the Caucasus foothills, 18th-century Sheki Khans' Palace with intricate Shebke stained glass, Sheki Caravanserai, Kish Albanian Church, local Sheki Halva tasting.
